name: Baths
source:
Estranged from your parents, you leave home in search of a new life. Things seem to be looking up when you find work at an old inn. As an employee, you're tasked with all sorts of work: maintaining the front desk, cleaning guest rooms, and tidying up the baths. 

After a co-worker unexpectedly quits, your main job is now in the kitchen working close with the owner, Mr. Tokuri, whose famous soup is "to die for."

[From [url=https://buntan.itch.io/baths]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与父母疏远后，你离开家去寻找新的生活。当你在一家老旅馆找到工作时，一切似乎都在好转。作为一名员工，你要承担各种各样的工作：维护前台、打扫客房、打扫浴室。

在一位同事意外辞职后，你现在的主要工作是在厨房里与老板德栗先生密切合作，他的著名汤“好吃极了”。

[来自[url=https://buntan.itch.io/baths]Itch.io[/url]]
